entries.answer:
लारी कार्डियोलॉजी (LARI Cardiology) में अपॉइंटमेंट लेने के लिए आप निम्नलिखित तरीकों का उपयोग कर सकते हैं:

1. **ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट (ORS):** आप [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) पर जाकर अपना अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं। वहां 'KGMU' चुनें और अपनी जानकारी भरें।
2. **SMS के माध्यम से:** आप अपने मोबाइल से **"APPOINTMENT <NAME>"** लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भेज सकते हैं।

entries.answer:

*   **Flow:** Select State (Uttar Pradesh) → Select Hospital (KGMU) → Click 'New Appointment' → Choose Department, Date & Time Slot → Enter patient details → Pay ₹50 online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS: **"Appointment [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**. You will receive a booking confirmation.

**Important Information:**
*   **Registration Fee:** ₹50 (flat rate for all booking methods).
*   **Important:** Please carry your Aadhaar card and the appointment slip/SMS confirmation when you visit the hospital.
*   **Outside-city patients:** Please ensure you have a valid referral for your specific department.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book in advance to avoid long wait times.

*   You will receive an OTP on your mobile to verify your registration.
*   Pay the **₹50 fee** at the counter to collect your physical OPD slip.

*   OPD registration counters are open from **9:00 AM to 1:00 PM** (Monday–Friday) and **9:00 AM to 12:00 PM** (Saturday).

4.  **Counseling Websites:**
    *   All India Quota ke liye: [www.mcc.nic.in](https://www.mcc.nic.in)
    *   UP State Quota ke liye: [www.upneet.gov.in](https://www.upneet.gov.in)

Kripya dhyan dein ki AI (main) cutoff ki bhavishyavani nahi kar sakta, isliye aapko counseling ke samay official cutoff aur merit lists par nazar rakhni hogi.
